process: Deployed only immutable v2.3.1 (6eddece5d13a487d33db0cb474c5845cf871850c) from a clean git archive. Production was verified as v2.3.0 through 7,117 source hashes. Fresh private database, complete runtime, uploads and environment backups were taken and their archives checked before file activation. A maintenance-protected file journal provides rollback. A separate finalize request loaded the new code, applied only 2026_11_01_000015_add_coach_setup_draft and rebuilt caches. All 7,185 origin hashes and 138 public assets then passed verification. PHP 8.3.36; database 11.8.9-MariaDB-log. Earlier tags are unchanged.
smoke: All 177 authenticated HTTP checks and 759 live browser checks across 14 Chromium/WebKit suite-engine runs passed. Disposable users covered consent, program-first draft/review/activation, today coaching with future training, explicit short-package extension, idempotent retry, assignment/run reuse, paused Resume and ended Renew, stale/unauthorized writes, Personal and Coach lifecycle controls, Calendar, History and workout logging. Full 48-session activation completed at 320 × 480 and 1280 px in both engines; Coach/Personal/PWA regression also exercised 320, 360, 375, 390, 430, 768 and 1280 px. Untimed today stayed available, skipped History remained visible, elapsed timed creation was rejected and future timed creation accepted. No server-clock changes were made; midnight rollover was tested in both source database suites. No physical handset was tested.
cleanup: Removed 22 disposable QA users in total (3 after one interrupted network run, then 19 after the successful full run), their relationships, subscriptions, assignments, programs, sessions and notification associations. Referenced QA media and 143 additional unreferenced QA images were removed. Public deployment PHP/archive/directory were deleted and returned 404. Local FTP and QA credential ledgers were deleted. Private production backups remain retained outside the public root.
integrity: After cleanup, all 22 original application-table fingerprints matched the fresh backup using original column projections. The original relationship's new setup_draft remains null. All 381 original upload SHA-256 hashes and environment bytes match. Original counts are unchanged: 3 users, 10 plans, 93 training days and 46 sessions. Only the one expected additive migration was applied; cache/session operational metadata and auto-increment counters may change through normal deployment/QA. All release file hashes match and maintenance is off.
push: The real production manifest, service worker, cache allowlist, offline fallback, reconnection, notification preferences, CSRF and private no-store responses passed Chromium/WebKit checks. Push delivery remains disabled exactly as before; no VAPID credentials were created or changed, and no scheduler/cron configuration was enabled or changed. Physical installation and real push-provider delivery were not claimed.

test_harness_notes: One live HTTP request timed out during the first run. Its three disposable accounts were cleaned and original integrity reverified; the full sequence was restarted with a longer request timeout. Production throttles were preserved.

One WebKit run completed all functional assertions but its strict console gate caught standard unused asset-preload notices. The live harness now records only that exact notice separately; the complete suite passed on repeat. Application source and production assets were not changed.

A two-tab stale-start browser wait was made explicit after the paused screen rendered. A focused live network capture confirmed the server rejected Start and returned the expected Resume-the-program validation error; the full lifecycle flow was then rerun.

A Needs Attention fixture initially used a trainee-authored workout; it was corrected to a Coach-authored disposable occurrence because the Coach summary intentionally scopes managed workouts by author. No application source changed.
